nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-01.prompt: Find the positive integer $n$ for which $\sqrt[3]{26+15\sqrt3}+\sqrt[3]{26-15\sqrt3}=n$

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-02.prompt: Find all values of $\cos x$ satisfying the equation $$25\cos 3x = 6\cos x.$$

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-03.prompt: A circle of radius $r$ is cut in half and each half is then folded into the shape of a cone. Compute the volume of each cone.

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-06.prompt: If brackets denote the greatest integer function, compute all real values of $x$ such that $$6x = 7+\left[x^2\right]$$

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-07.prompt: Find all values of $x$ satisfying the equation $x^{\frac35}+7x^{\frac{3}{10}}=8$.
nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-07.answer: $x=1$ (the official corrected answer also allows the complex values $\frac{-1\pm i\sqrt3}{2}$)

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-08.prompt: What is the positive value of $\tan x$ if $61\tan x=60\sec x$?

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-09.prompt: If $x+x^{-1}=2\sqrt2$, compute $\left[x^5+x^{-5}\right]$ where the brackets signify the greatest integer function.

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-10.prompt: An equiangular dodecagon ($12$ sides) is inscribed in a circle. If two consecutive sides of this dodecagon have lengths $\sqrt7$ and $2\sqrt{21}$, compute the area of the circle.

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-11.prompt: Find the value of $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{100}n(n!)$. [Answer may be left in simple factorial form.]

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-12.prompt: A cube whose edge has length $n$ is assembled by fastening $n^3$ unit cubes together. The large cube is painted and then separated into the unit cubes again. Allow $N(x)$ to represent the number of unit cubes which have exactly $x$ faces painted. For how many values of $n$ is the quantity $\dfrac{N(0)\,N(2)}{N(1)\,N(3)}$ a positive integer less than $1989$?

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-13.prompt: Assuming a limit, find the value of $\sqrt{3\sqrt{24\sqrt{3\sqrt{24\sqrt{3\cdots}}}}}$

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-14.prompt: Solve for all real values of $\tan x$ such that $3\tan x+4=\sec x$

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-15.prompt: If $42a^2-71ab+30b^2=0$ find the POSITIVE integers $a$ and $b$ which satisfy the equation so that $a+b$ is a minimum. Express your answer as $(a,b)$.

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-16.prompt: If the geometric mean of $\log_2 17$, $\log_8 17$ and $\log_{512}17$ is $\log_k 17$, then compute the value of $k$.

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-17.prompt: Let $f(x)=[x]+[2x]+[4x]$. If the solution set of $f(x)=10$ is $\{x \text{ such that } a\le x<b\}$, find the ordered pair $(a,b)$.

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-20.prompt: Find all possible values of $\tan x$ such that $9\sin x+2\cos x=6$.

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-21.prompt: Assuming a limit, compute the value of $\sqrt{3\sqrt[3]{288\sqrt{3\sqrt[3]{288\sqrt{3\cdots}}}}}$

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-22.prompt: Find both possible values of $\log_y x$ if $x^4-\left(\frac xy\right)^3-xy^4+y=0$.

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-23.prompt: How many positive integers less than $100$ can be expressed as $[2x]+[3x]$ for some real number $x$.

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-24.prompt: A coin is flipped until a head appears. Then the coin is flipped again until a head appears once again. What is the probability that the number of flips in the second experiment is at least three times the number of flips in the first?

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-25.prompt: Assuming a limit, compute the value of $x$ if $$2^x=\sqrt[2]{2\sqrt[3]{2\sqrt[4]{2\sqrt[2]{2\sqrt[3]{2\sqrt[4]{2\sqrt[2]{2\cdots}}}}}}}$$

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-26.prompt: Suppose $z$ is a root (possibly complex) of $z^4+z^3+z^2+z+1=0$. Compute the value of $z^5$.

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-27.prompt: Find all ordered pairs of positive integers $(x,y)$ such that $$(3^x)(8^y)=2^{7x+2y+1}+2^{2x+3y-1}$$

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-28.prompt: Suppose that $f$ is a function defined for positive values of $x$, such that $$11f(x+1)+5f(x^{-1}+1)=\log_{10}x.$$ Compute the value of $f(6)+f(17)+f(126)$.

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-29.prompt: If $[a]$ denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to $a$, find the least $x$ such that $$[x]+[5x]+[25x]+[125x]=10^3.$$

nyciml-1990-91-spring-seniora-30.prompt: Compute the probability of getting exactly $3$ heads in $6$ tosses of a coin if we know for sure that at least one head will appear in the first three tosses.
